name: Praetorian Acquisition Corp. Class A Ordinary Shares
summary: Praetorian Acquisition Corp. functions as a blank check company, specifically a Special Purpose Acquisition Company (SPAC). This entity was established with the explicit goal of completing a business combination, which could involve a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, or a corporate reorganization with one or more target enterprises. The company was founded on September 29, 2025, and its main corporate office is situated in Miami, Florida.
